messages.subject: Project Larkspur - Heads of Terms (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla,

Attached are the Heads of Terms for Kestrel House reflecting the agreed price of £14.25m (net initial yield 7.30% on passing rent of £1,041,500). They include a 6-week exclusivity and the TOGC VAT treatment. These are subject to contract.

Please confirm you're happy and we'll send to Castle & Vane.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate - Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
